context_title:
Create a complete, production-ready, AI-based research, conversation, memory, document-processing, multimodal, and sandboxed-execution web application from scratch for Replit. The solution must be complete, unabridged, directly runnable, and use real integrations. No mock, placeholder, pseudo-code, demo-only, fake response, TODO, stub, simplified, or temporary solution is allowed. The entire backend may exist exclusively in a single file. The entire frontend may exist exclusively in a single index.html file, and all views, routes, subpages, modals, states, components, styles, and client-side logic must be implemented in it as well. In the output, provide the complete file structure and the full content of every file. Do not leave anything out. Do not explain what you would do: implement it fully.

Technology constraint:
	•	Backend: Python 3 + FastAPI, in a single file, filename: app.py
	•	Frontend: a single file, filename: index.html
	•	Runtime: uvicorn
	•	Replit-compatible project
	•	Additional files allowed: requirements.txt, .replit, .env.example, README.md
	•	The application logic on the backend side may exist exclusively in app.py
	•	The entire client-side UI, CSS, and JavaScript may exist exclusively in index.html

System goal:
Build a complete AI workspace that can do:
	•	multi-model textual and multimodal AI usage
	•	long-context chat
	•	deep web research
	•	source-cited answering
	•	memory retrieval and memory updates
	•	document upload and document-based question answering
	•	sandboxed code execution
	•	computer-like, multi-step execution in an isolated environment
	•	agent orchestration
	•	multimodal input and output
	•	real user authentication and persistent state management

Required integrations:
	1.	Azure AI Project agent integration
Implement a complete adapter for using the following two agent_references:

	•	name: last, version: 3, type: agent_reference
	•	name: bibi, version: 3, type: agent_reference

The backend must contain real Azure AI Project client initialization, using openai_client, with responses.create calls and the extra_body agent_reference parameter. These two agents must not be demos; they must be fully usable model/agent options in the system.
	2.	FriendlyAI API GLM-5 integration
GLM-5 must be a first-class model option. A real adapter must be created for it. It must be wired into the model selector, the chat pipeline, the agent routing, and streaming response delivery where the API supports it. If a function cannot be streamed, handle it with correct fallback logic.
	3.	Grok API integration
Create a complete adapter for the following:

	•	Grok 4.1 text model
	•	Grok image generation
	•	Grok image-to-video
Each must be registered separately in the model/provider registry with its own capabilities.

	4.	FlyMy AI API integration
Create a complete adapter for the following:

	•	Nano Banana 2
	•	Nano Banana Pro
	•	Sora 2
	•	Sora 2 Pro
Support image generation, multimodal input, and where relevant video generation or image-to-video workflows.

	5.	Exa AI integration
Exa must be the search and research engine. The system must use maximum-capacity configuration for every Exa-based search as far as the API allows:

	•	high result limit, target value 100
	•	AI summary always enabled
	•	websets usage where relevant
	•	multi-round query expansion
	•	result clustering
	•	relevance-based ranking
	•	domain filtering
	•	recency filtering
	•	deduplication
	•	source extraction
	•	evidence synthesis
	•	final citation generation

	6.	SuperMemory AI integration
Implement the memory layer with the SuperMemory API. Required features:

	•	save memory
	•	retrieve memory
	•	list memories
	•	delete memory
	•	inject relevant memories before answering
	•	automatic memory extraction from conversation
	•	per-user and per-chat memory

	7.	Dragonfly Cloud and SingleStore integration
Use both with real separated roles:

	•	Dragonfly Cloud: cache, session state, stream buffer, job state, websocket state, locks, temporary runtime state
	•	SingleStore: persistent data, users, sessions, chats, messages, memory metadata, file metadata, research jobs, sandbox runs, agent traces, settings, source metadata, tool logs

	8.	Daytona.io integration
Build a complete sandbox management layer with the Daytona API. Required:

	•	sandbox create
	•	sandbox reuse
	•	sandbox destroy
	•	shell command execution
	•	Python code execution
	•	stdout/stderr reading
	•	log streaming
	•	timeout handling
	•	file upload into the sandbox
	•	file reading from the sandbox
	•	execution history
	•	fault tolerance

	9.	Modal.com and TensorMesh compatibility
Build a provider adapter abstraction for self-hosted models. The system must be able to add new models from Modal or TensorMesh based endpoints based on capability metadata. The routing logic must handle:

	•	model name
	•	provider
	•	context window
	•	capabilities
	•	preferred use case
	•	latency preference
	•	priority
	•	health state
Do not implement pricing, quota, or billing logic.

Main architecture:
The single file app.py must contain:
	•	FastAPI initialization
	•	configuration management
	•	environment variable validation at startup
	•	database initialization and schema creation
	•	auth logic
	•	session logic
	•	provider registry
	•	model registry
	•	agent registry
	•	chat orchestration
	•	research orchestration
	•	memory orchestration
	•	file processing pipeline
	•	sandbox manager
	•	multimodal manager
	•	websocket or streaming endpoints
	•	admin and health endpoints
	•	complete error handling
	•	structured logging
	•	security middleware
	•	static serving of index.html

The single file index.html must contain:
	•	full CSS
	•	full JavaScript
	•	full HTML markup
	•	client-side route handling
	•	state management
	•	auth screens
	•	dashboard
	•	chat list
	•	main chat view
	•	model selector
	•	mode selector
	•	research panel
	•	source panel
	•	memory panel
	•	file upload panel
	•	file preview
	•	agent activity panel
	•	sandbox terminal panel
	•	settings modal
	•	toast system
	•	streaming rendering
	•	markdown rendering
	•	code block rendering
	•	syntax highlighting
	•	citation click handling
	•	mobile-friendly layout
	•	dark/light theme support

Functional requirements in detail:
	1.	Auth and user system
Implement a complete auth system:

	•	registration
	•	login
	•	logout
	•	secure password hashing
	•	session cookie or token
	•	route protection
	•	user profile
	•	settings saving
	•	session check on startup
	•	authorization checks on every protected endpoint

	2.	Chat system
Implement a complete chat system:

	•	create new chat
	•	automatic chat title generation
	•	chat list
	•	open chat
	•	delete chat
	•	archive chat
	•	pin chat
	•	load previous messages
	•	send message
	•	streamed responses
	•	stop response
	•	model selection per chat or per message
	•	research mode selection
	•	tool/agent run display
	•	citation display

	3.	Research modes
There must be three operating modes:

	•	Quick Search: fast web search and short answer
	•	Deep Research: multi-round Exa-based research, content retrieval, synthesis, sources
	•	Autonomous Run: agent-driven research plan, multiple steps, partial results, final summary

Required steps of the Deep Research pipeline:
	•	analyze the user request
	•	create a query plan
	•	query expansion
	•	multiple Exa searches
	•	merge results
	•	retrieve/process content
	•	relevance scoring
	•	merge evidence
	•	extract citable source snippets
	•	generate answer
	•	follow-up suggestions
	•	save research log

	4.	Provider and model routing
Create a common adapter interface for every model. Every provider must register:

	•	name
	•	provider_type
	•	supported capabilities
	•	streaming support
	•	image support
	•	video support
	•	tool use support
	•	reasoning support
	•	health check function
	•	invoke function
	•	optional async job polling

Implement intelligent routing based on the following inputs:
	•	explicit model selection by the user
	•	requested capability
	•	multimodal requirement
	•	sandbox requirement
	•	research mode
	•	long-context necessity
	•	agent preference
	•	fallback chain
	•	provider health

	5.	Agent system
Create an agent registry and at least the following logical agents:

	•	router_agent
	•	research_agent
	•	browse_agent
	•	summarizer_agent
	•	memory_agent
	•	coding_agent
	•	sandbox_agent
	•	citation_agent
	•	multimodal_agent
	•	planner_agent
	•	azure_last_agent
	•	azure_bibi_agent

The agent system must be able to:
	•	select an agent based on task type
	•	run multiple agents sequentially
	•	store intermediate state
	•	log tool calls
	•	stream partial results
	•	assemble the final answer

	6.	File upload and document processing
Supported file types at minimum:

	•	txt
	•	md
	•	pdf
	•	docx
	•	html
	•	csv
	•	json
	•	png
	•	jpg
	•	jpeg
	•	webp

Required:
	•	file upload over HTTP
	•	metadata saving
	•	physical storage locally in the Replit filesystem or under a configurable storage path
	•	content extraction
	•	PDF text extraction
	•	DOCX text extraction
	•	CSV reading
	•	HTML cleaning
	•	image metadata extraction
	•	assigning a file to a chat
	•	file-based question answering pipeline
	•	listing and deleting uploaded files

	7.	Sandbox and computer-like execution
From the sandbox panel, the user must be able to:

	•	create a sandbox
	•	run a command
	•	run a Python script
	•	view logs
	•	stop the sandbox
	•	initiate a sandbox operation from chat

The system must be capable of multi-step execution tasks where:
	•	the model creates a plan
	•	the sandbox agent executes commands
	•	it reads back the output
	•	if necessary it performs another step
	•	finally it returns the answer in structured form into the chat

	8.	Multimodal functions
Required frontend functions:

	•	image upload to chat input
	•	image preview
	•	image generation from prompt
	•	start image-to-video task
	•	display generation status
	•	result list
	•	open media items

Required backend functions:
	•	multimodal input processing
	•	provider selection based on capability
	•	asynchronous job handling for video generation
	•	status polling
	•	saving and serving results

	9.	Data model
Create the required tables in SingleStore on startup. There must be at least:

	•	users
	•	sessions
	•	chats
	•	messages
	•	user_settings
	•	memories
	•	files
	•	file_chunks or file_contents
	•	research_jobs
	•	research_sources
	•	sandbox_runs
	•	agent_traces
	•	provider_logs

Everywhere there must be:
	•	id
	•	created_at
	•	updated_at
	•	where needed deleted_at
	•	audit fields
	•	necessary indexes
	•	JSON fields where justified

Keep in Dragonfly:
	•	session state
	•	stream state
	•	temporary research state
	•	sandbox runtime state
	•	websocket state
	•	locks

	10.	API endpoints
Implement at least the following:

Auth:
	•	POST /api/auth/register
	•	POST /api/auth/login
	•	POST /api/auth/logout
	•	GET /api/auth/me

Settings:
	•	GET /api/settings
	•	PUT /api/settings

Chats:
	•	GET /api/chats
	•	POST /api/chats
	•	GET /api/chats/{chat_id}
	•	DELETE /api/chats/{chat_id}
	•	POST /api/chats/{chat_id}/archive
	•	POST /api/chats/{chat_id}/pin

Messages:
	•	GET /api/chats/{chat_id}/messages
	•	POST /api/chats/{chat_id}/messages
	•	POST /api/chats/{chat_id}/stream

Models and providers:
	•	GET /api/models
	•	GET /api/providers/health

Research:
	•	POST /api/research/search
	•	POST /api/research/deep
	•	GET /api/research/{job_id}
	•	GET /api/research/{job_id}/sources

Memory:
	•	GET /api/memories
	•	POST /api/memories
	•	PUT /api/memories/{memory_id}
	•	DELETE /api/memories/{memory_id}

Files:
	•	POST /api/files/upload
	•	GET /api/files
	•	GET /api/files/{file_id}
	•	DELETE /api/files/{file_id}
	•	POST /api/files/{file_id}/ask

Sandbox:
	•	POST /api/sandboxes
	•	POST /api/sandboxes/{sandbox_id}/run
	•	GET /api/sandboxes/{sandbox_id}/logs
	•	DELETE /api/sandboxes/{sandbox_id}

Multimodal:
	•	POST /api/multimodal/generate-image
	•	POST /api/multimodal/image-to-video
	•	GET /api/multimodal/jobs/{job_id}

Agents:
	•	POST /api/agents/run
	•	GET /api/agents/{run_id}

Admin:
	•	GET /health
	•	GET /api/admin/diagnostics

	11.	Streaming
Implement real streamed response delivery. Use SSE or WebSocket. The frontend must render the answer token by token or chunk by chunk. Support:

	•	interruption
	•	partial tool output
	•	agent status updates
	•	research progress
	•	sandbox log streaming

	12.	Frontend behavior
In index.html there must be a full-featured modern UI:

	•	left sidebar with conversations
	•	chat in the center
	•	right-side panel with switchable tabs: Sources, Memory, Files, Agents, Sandbox
	•	top toolbar with model selector and mode selector
	•	bottom multimodal composer
	•	drag and drop file upload
	•	on citation click, source snippet in side panel
	•	markdown and code block rendering
	•	copy button
	•	toast messages
	•	settings modal
	•	login/register screen
	•	state persistence
	•	responsive layout

	13.	Security
Required:

	•	input validation
	•	XSS protection
	•	output sanitization
	•	secure cookie settings
	•	password hashing
	•	auth verification
	•	protection against SQL injection
	•	file type checking
	•	file size limit
	•	sandbox isolation
	•	CORS configuration
	•	prevent logging of sensitive data

	14.	Configuration
All secrets and configuration must come from environment variables. There must be a complete .env.example with the full key list. Variables to validate at minimum:

	•	SECRET_KEY
	•	SESSION_SECRET
	•	SINGLESTORE_HOST
	•	SINGLESTORE_PORT
	•	SINGLESTORE_DATABASE
	•	SINGLESTORE_USER
	•	SINGLESTORE_PASSWORD
	•	DRAGONFLY_HOST
	•	DRAGONFLY_PORT
	•	DRAGONFLY_PASSWORD
	•	EXA_API_KEY
	•	SUPERMEMORY_API_KEY
	•	GROK_API_KEY
	•	FLYMY_AI_API_KEY
	•	DAYTONA_API_KEY
	•	FRIENDLIAI_API_KEY
	•	TENSORMESH_API_KEY
	•	MODAL_TOKEN_ID
	•	MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET
	•	AZURE_AI_PROJECT_ENDPOINT
	•	AZURE_CLIENT_ID
	•	AZURE_TENANT_ID
	•	AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
	•	FILE_STORAGE_PATH
	•	APP_BASE_URL

Validate every required configuration variable at startup. If anything is missing, the server must stop with a detailed, clear error.
	15.	Observability
Implement:

	•	structured logging
	•	request id
	•	provider latency measurement
	•	agent trace saving
	•	sandbox execution log
	•	research run log
	•	health check
	•	diagnostics endpoint
	•	detailed error handling

	16.	Business restriction
There must be no pricing, billing, subscription, quota purchase, paywall, credit pack, or monetization logic of any kind. The system must be built for completely free usage. No pricing interface may appear in either the backend or the frontend.
	17.	Output format
Return the answer exactly in this form:
	18.	First the complete file structure
	19.	Then the full content of every file in separate blocks
	20.	At the start of every block, include the filename
	21.	Do not leave anything out
	22.	Do not provide a summary instead of code
	23.	Do not provide a partial implementation
	24.	Do not use abbreviations to omit code
	25.	Do not write things like “the rest is similar”, “omitted for brevity”, “placeholder”, “later”, “TODO”
	26.	Quality threshold
The final project must actually work for the following:

	•	registration and login
	•	new chat
	•	chat list
	•	model switching
	•	Azure agent usage
	•	GLM-5 usage
	•	Grok text and multimodal usage
	•	FlyMy multimodal usage
	•	Exa deep research
	•	SuperMemory memory
	•	Dragonfly + SingleStore state and persistence
	•	Daytona sandbox execution
	•	file upload and document processing
	•	streamed responses
	•	citation display
	•	source panel
	•	agent log panel
	•	sandbox panel
	•	settings saving
	•	responsive, interactive frontend

Now provide the complete project in the specified format, with full source code, ready for Replit, with app.py backend and index.html frontend, without any mock or abbreviation.

async def get_current_user(request: Request) -> Optional[dict]:
    token = request.cookies.get("access_token")
    if not token:
        auth_header = request.headers.get("Authorization", "")
        if auth_header.startswith("Bearer "):
            token = auth_header[7:]
    if not token:
        return None
    payload = decode_token(token)
    if not payload:
        return None
    user_id = payload.get("sub")
    if not user_id:
        return None
    user = await db_execute(
        "SELECT id, username, email, is_active, is_admin FROM users WHERE id = %s AND deleted_at IS NULL",
        (user_id,), fetch="one"
    )
    return user


async def require_user(request: Request) -> dict:
    user = await get_current_user(request)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Not authenticated")
    if not user.get("is_active"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Account disabled")
    return user

def route_model(
    requested_model: Optional[str] = None,
    capability: Optional[str] = None,
    multimodal: bool = False,
    sandbox: bool = False,
    research: bool = False,
    long_context: bool = False,
) -> str:
    if requested_model and requested_model in MODEL_REGISTRY:
        return requested_model
    candidates = list(MODEL_REGISTRY.values())
    if capability == "image_output":
        candidates = [m for m in candidates if m.capabilities.image_output]
    elif capability == "video_output":
        candidates = [m for m in candidates if m.capabilities.video_output]
    elif capability == "tool_use":
        candidates = [m for m in candidates if m.capabilities.tool_use]
    elif capability == "reasoning":
        candidates = [m for m in candidates if m.capabilities.reasoning]
    else:
        candidates = [m for m in candidates if m.capabilities.text]
    if multimodal:
        candidates = [m for m in candidates if m.capabilities.image_input or m.capabilities.text]
    if long_context:
        candidates = [m for m in candidates if m.capabilities.context_window >= 64000]
    if research:
        candidates = [m for m in candidates if "research" in m.preferred_use_cases]
    if candidates:
        return sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: -x.priority)[0].id
    return "grok-4.1"

async def azure_agent_invoke(
    agent_name: str, messages: List[dict], stream: bool = True
) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
    agent_ref_map = {
        "azure-last": {"name": "last", "version": 3},
        "azure-bibi": {"name": "bibi", "version": 3},
    }
    agent_ref = agent_ref_map.get(agent_name, {"name": "last", "version": 3})

    import openai
    client = openai.AsyncOpenAI(
        api_key=settings.AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET,
        base_url=settings.AZURE_AI_PROJECT_ENDPOINT,
    )

    extra_body = {
        "agent_reference": {
            "name": agent_ref["name"],
            "version": agent_ref["version"],
            "type": "agent_reference",
        }
    }

    start = time.time()
    try:
        if stream:
            async with client.responses.stream(
                model=agent_ref["name"],
                input=messages,
                extra_body=extra_body,
            ) as s:
                async for event in s:
                    delta = getattr(event, "delta", None)
                    if delta:
                        text = getattr(delta, "text", "") or ""
                        if text:
                            yield text
        else:
            response = await client.responses.create(
                model=agent_ref["name"],
                input=messages,
                extra_body=extra_body,
            )
            output_text = ""
            for item in (response.output or []):
                for content in (getattr(item, "content", None) or []):
                    output_text += getattr(content, "text", "") or ""
            yield output_text
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error("azure_agent_error", agent=agent_name, error=str(e))
        yield f"[Azure Agent Error: {e}]"
    finally:
        latency = int((time.time() - start) * 1000)
        asyncio.create_task(log_provider("azure", agent_name, "chat", latency, 0, 0, True, None))

                                         headers=headers, json={**payload, "stream": False})

async def exa_search(
    query: str,
    num_results: int = 100,
    use_autoprompt: bool = True,
    include_domains: List[str] = None,
    exclude_domains: List[str] = None,
    start_published_date: str = None,
    livecrawl: str = "always",
    summary: bool = True,
) -> List[dict]:
    from exa_py import Exa
    exa = Exa(api_key=settings.EXA_API_KEY)
    kwargs: dict = {
        "num_results": min(num_results, 100),
        "use_autoprompt": use_autoprompt,
        "type": "auto",
        "livecrawl": livecrawl,
        "text": {"max_characters": 5000},
        "summary": {"query": f"Summarize relevant information about: {query}"} if summary else None,
        "highlights": {"num_sentences": 5, "highlights_per_url": 3},
    }
    if include_domains:
        kwargs["include_domains"] = include_domains
    if exclude_domains:
        kwargs["exclude_domains"] = exclude_domains
    if start_published_date:
        kwargs["start_published_date"] = start_published_date

    # Remove None values
    kwargs = {k: v for k, v in kwargs.items() if v is not None}

    try:
        results = exa.search_and_contents(query, **kwargs)
        out = []
        seen_urls = set()
        for r in (results.results or []):
            url = getattr(r, "url", "") or ""
            if url in seen_urls:
                continue
            seen_urls.add(url)
            out.append({
                "id": getattr(r, "id", str(uuid.uuid4())),
                "url": url,
                "title": getattr(r, "title", "") or "",
                "text": getattr(r, "text", "") or "",
                "summary": getattr(r, "summary", "") or "",
                "highlights": getattr(r, "highlights", []) or [],
                "score": getattr(r, "score", 0.0) or 0.0,
                "published_date": getattr(r, "published_date", "") or "",
                "author": getattr(r, "author", "") or "",
            })
        return sorted(out, key=lambda x: -(x.get("score") or 0.0))
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error("exa_search_error", error=str(e))
        return []


async def exa_deep_research(query: str, model_id: str = "grok-4.1") -> dict:
    job_id = str(uuid.uuid4())

    async def run_deep():
        try:
            # Step 1: Analyze & plan
            plan_messages = [
                {"role": "system", "content": "You are a research planner. Given a query, produce 5 diverse search queries to cover all angles. Return as JSON: {\"queries\": [...]}"},
                {"role": "user", "content": f"Research query: {query}"}
            ]
            plan_text = ""
            async for chunk in route_and_invoke(model_id, plan_messages, stream=False):
                plan_text += chunk

            try:
                queries_data = json.loads(re.search(r'\{.*\}', plan_text, re.DOTALL).group())
                sub_queries = queries_data.get("queries", [query])[:5]
            except Exception:
                sub_queries = [query, f"{query} latest research", f"{query} overview", f"{query} examples", f"{query} analysis"]

            # Step 2: Multi-round Exa searches
            all_results = []
            for sq in sub_queries:
                results = await exa_search(sq, num_results=20, summary=True, livecrawl="always")
                all_results.extend(results)

            # Deduplicate by URL
            seen = set()
            unique_results = []
            for r in all_results:
                if r["url"] not in seen:
                    seen.add(r["url"])
                    unique_results.append(r)

            # Step 3: Score & rank
            unique_results = sorted(unique_results, key=lambda x: -(x.get("score") or 0.0))[:30]

            # Step 4: Build evidence context
            evidence_parts = []
            for i, r in enumerate(unique_results[:15]):
                snippet = r.get("summary") or r.get("text", "")[:1000]
                evidence_parts.append(f"[{i+1}] {r['title']}\nURL: {r['url']}\n{snippet}\n")

            evidence_context = "\n---\n".join(evidence_parts)

            # Step 5: Synthesize answer
            synthesis_messages = [
                {"role": "system", "content": (
                    "You are a world-class research analyst. Based on the provided sources, "
                    "write a comprehensive, well-structured research report. "
                    "Cite every claim with [N] referring to the source number. "
                    "Include sections: Summary, Key Findings, Detailed Analysis, Conclusions, Follow-up Questions. "
                    "Be thorough and accurate."
                )},
                {"role": "user", "content": f"Research query: {query}\n\nSources:\n{evidence_context}"}
            ]

            answer_parts = []
            async for chunk in route_and_invoke(model_id, synthesis_messages, stream=False):
                answer_parts.append(chunk)
            answer = "".join(answer_parts)

            # Save sources
            for r in unique_results[:30]:
                src_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                await db_execute(
                    "INSERT INTO research_sources (id, job_id, url, title, snippet, full_content, relevance_score) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)",
                    (src_id, job_id, r["url"][:1999], r["title"][:500], r.get("summary","")[:1000],
                     r.get("text","")[:5000], float(r.get("score") or 0.0))
                )

            result = {
                "answer": answer,
                "sources": unique_results[:30],
                "sub_queries": sub_queries,
                "total_sources_found": len(all_results),
            }
            await db_execute(
                "UPDATE research_jobs SET status='completed', result_json=%s, completed_at=NOW() WHERE id=%s",
                (json.dumps(result), job_id)
            )
        except Exception as e:
            await db_execute(
                "UPDATE research_jobs SET status='failed', error_message=%s WHERE id=%s",
                (str(e)[:2000], job_id)
            )

    asyncio.create_task(run_deep())
    return {"job_id": job_id, "status": "running"}

def extract_text_from_file(file_path: Path, mime_type: str) -> str:
    ext = file_path.suffix.lower().lstrip(".")
    try:
        if ext in ("txt", "md"):
            return file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        elif ext == "pdf":
            import PyPDF2
            text_parts = []
            with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
                reader = PyPDF2.PdfReader(f)
                for page in reader.pages:
                    text_parts.append(page.extract_text() or "")
            return "\n".join(text_parts)
        elif ext == "docx":
            from docx import Document
            doc = Document(str(file_path))
            return "\n".join(p.text for p in doc.paragraphs)
        elif ext == "html":
            soup = BeautifulSoup(file_path.read_bytes(), "html.parser")
            return soup.get_text(separator="\n")
        elif ext == "csv":
            return file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        elif ext == "json":
            data = json.loads(file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            return json.dumps(data, indent=2)
        elif ext in ("png", "jpg", "jpeg", "webp"):
            img = Image.open(str(file_path))
            meta = f"Image: {img.format}, mode={img.mode}, size={img.size}"
            return meta
        return ""
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning("text_extraction_failed", path=str(file_path), error=str(e))
        return ""

async def route_and_invoke(
    model_id: str,
    messages: List[dict],
    stream: bool = True,
) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
    model = MODEL_REGISTRY.get(model_id)
    if not model:
        model_id = "grok-4.1"
        model = MODEL_REGISTRY["grok-4.1"]

    if model.provider == "azure":
        async for chunk in azure_agent_invoke(model_id, messages, stream=stream):
            yield chunk
    elif model.provider == "friendliai":
        async for chunk in glm5_invoke(messages, stream=stream):
            yield chunk
    elif model.provider == "grok" and model.capabilities.text:
        async for chunk in grok_text_invoke(messages, model="grok-3-latest", stream=stream):
            yield chunk
    elif model.provider_type == "custom_endpoint":
        endpoint = CUSTOM_ENDPOINTS.get(model_id, "")
        if endpoint:
            async for chunk in generic_openai_invoke(endpoint, model_id, messages, stream):
                yield chunk
        else:
            yield f"[Custom endpoint for {model_id} not configured]"
    else:
        # Default fallback to Grok
        async for chunk in grok_text_invoke(messages, model="grok-3-latest", stream=stream):
            yield chunk


async def generic_openai_invoke(
    base_url: str, model_id: str, messages: List[dict], stream: bool = True,
    api_key: str = ""
) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key or settings.TENSORMESH_API_KEY}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }
    payload = {"model": model_id, "messages": messages, "stream": stream}
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=180) as client:
        if stream:
            async with client.stream("POST", f"{base_url}/chat/completions",
                                      headers=headers, json=payload) as resp:
                async for line in resp.aiter_lines():
                    if line.startswith("data: "):
                        data = line[6:]
                        if data.strip() == "[DONE]":
                            break
                        try:
                            obj = json.loads(data)
                            text = obj.get("choices", [{}])[0].get("delta", {}).get("content", "")
                            if text:
                                yield text
                        except Exception:
                            pass
        else:
            resp = await client.post(f"{base_url}/chat/completions",
                                      headers=headers, json={**payload, "stream": False})
            resp.raise_for_status()
            yield resp.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]

async def run_agent(
    agent_name: str,
    task: str,
    context: dict,
    user_id: str,
    chat_id: str = None,
    run_id: str = None,
) -> dict:
    run_id = run_id or str(uuid.uuid4())
    trace_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    agent_conf = AGENT_REGISTRY.get(agent_name, {"model": "grok-4.1", "description": "General agent"})
    model_id = agent_conf["model"]
    start = time.time()

    await db_execute(
        "INSERT INTO agent_traces (id, user_id, chat_id, run_id, agent_name, input_json, status) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,'running')",
        (trace_id, user_id, chat_id, run_id, agent_name, json.dumps({"task": task, "context": context}))
    )

    system_prompts = {
        "router_agent": "You are a routing agent. Analyze the user task and determine which agent or tool should handle it. Return JSON: {\"agent\": \"agent_name\", \"reason\": \"...\"}",
        "research_agent": "You are a research agent. Synthesize information from provided sources to answer the question comprehensively. Cite sources with [N].",
        "browse_agent": "You are a web browsing agent. Extract and summarize key information from web content.",
        "summarizer_agent": "You are a summarization agent. Create concise, accurate summaries preserving key information.",
        "memory_agent": "You are a memory management agent. Extract important facts, preferences, and information to save for future reference.",
        "coding_agent": "You are an expert coding agent. Write clean, working, well-commented code.",
        "sandbox_agent": "You are a sandbox execution agent. Plan and execute code step by step, reading output and adjusting as needed.",
        "citation_agent": "You are a citation agent. Generate proper citations for all referenced sources.",
        "multimodal_agent": "You are a multimodal agent. Handle image and video generation requests, describing what will be created.",
        "planner_agent": "You are a planning agent. Create detailed step-by-step plans for complex tasks. Return JSON with steps array.",
        "azure_last_agent": "You are the Azure Last agent, a powerful AI assistant.",
        "azure_bibi_agent": "You are the Azure Bibi agent, a powerful AI assistant.",
    }
    system_prompt = system_prompts.get(agent_name, "You are a helpful AI agent.")

    messages = [
        {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
        {"role": "user", "content": f"Task: {task}\n\nContext: {json.dumps(context)}"},
    ]

    output_parts = []
    try:
        async for chunk in route_and_invoke(model_id, messages, stream=False):
            output_parts.append(chunk)
        output = "".join(output_parts)
        latency = int((time.time() - start) * 1000)

            (json.dumps({"output": output}), latency, trace_id)
        )
        return {"run_id": run_id, "agent": agent_name, "output": output, "status": "completed"}
    except Exception as e:
        latency = int((time.time() - start) * 1000)
        await db_execute(

            (json.dumps({"error": str(e)}), latency, trace_id)

async def auto_extract_memory(user_id: str, chat_id: str, user_msg: str, assistant_msg: str):
    try:
        check_messages = [
            {"role": "system", "content": "Does this conversation contain any important facts, preferences, or information worth remembering? If yes, return JSON: {\"should_save\": true, \"content\": \"<what to remember>\"}. If no, return {\"should_save\": false}."},
            {"role": "user", "content": f"User: {user_msg[:500]}\nAssistant: {assistant_msg[:500]}"},
        ]
        parts = []
        async for chunk in route_and_invoke("grok-4.1", check_messages, stream=False):
            parts.append(chunk)
        text = "".join(parts)
        match = re.search(r'\{.*\}', text, re.DOTALL)
        if match:
            data = json.loads(match.group())
            if data.get("should_save") and data.get("content"):

    )

        "SELECT role, content FROM messages WHERE chat_id=%s AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 50",
        (chat_id,), fetch="all"
    )

    collected = []

    async def generate():
        try:
            # Send start event
            yield f"data: {json.dumps({'type': 'start', 'message_id': asst_msg_id})}\n\n"

    request: Request,
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    chat_id: str = Form(None),
):
    user = await require_user(request)

    ext = Path(file.filename or "").suffix.lower().lstrip(".")
    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"File type .{ext} not allowed")

    content = await file.read()
    if len(content) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=413, detail="File too large (max 50MB)")

    file_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    safe_name = f"{file_id}.{ext}"
    file_path = storage_path / safe_name

    async with aiofiles.open(file_path, "wb") as f:
        await f.write(content)

    mime = file.content_type or mimetypes.guess_type(file.filename or "")[0] or "application/octet-stream"
    extracted = extract_text_from_file(file_path, mime)

    await db_execute(
        "INSERT INTO files (id, user_id, chat_id, filename, original_name, mime_type, file_size, storage_path, extracted_text) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)",
        (file_id, user["id"], chat_id, safe_name, file.filename or "file", mime,
         len(content), str(file_path), extracted[:65000])
    )

    # Store in chunks
    chunk_size = 10000
    for i, start_idx in enumerate(range(0, len(extracted), chunk_size)):
        chunk = extracted[start_idx:start_idx + chunk_size]
        await db_execute(
            "INSERT INTO file_contents (id, file_id, chunk_index, content) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s)",
            (str(uuid.uuid4()), file_id, i, chunk)
        )

                chat_id = data.get("chat_id")
                content = data.get("content", "")
                model_id = data.get("model_id", "grok-4.1")

                await websocket.send_json({"type": "stream_start"})
                collected = []
                async for chunk in route_and_invoke(model_id, [{"role": "user", "content": content}], stream=True):
                    collected.append(chunk)
                    await websocket.send_json({"type": "chunk", "text": chunk})

                await websocket.send_json({"type": "stream_done", "full_text": "".join(collected)})

            elif msg_type == "ping":
                await websocket.send_json({"type": "pong"})

    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        pass
    finally:
        active_connections.pop(user_id, None)
        await redis.delete(f"ws:connected:{user_id}")
